verdict.rationale: Cua ships an official `cua` CLI. The docs reference commands such as `cua runtime doctor` and `cua runtime setup`, following agent work in Spaces from the CLI, and a one-command uninstall of the cua CLI. Cua Driver lets agents drive native apps through MCP or a CLI, and a community user reports about five days of reasonable hands-on use of the Lume CLI to sandbox Claude. missing for 10: a comprehensive CLI command reference in the evidence.
